description: Write meaningful unit tests for a parser without changing it; a hidden mutant must make them fail.
turns: The project in {workspace} has a DurationParser with only one test. Add unit tests that cover what its documentation promises: every unit, combinations, spaces, and the inputs it must reject. Do not change the parser itself.

checks.name: tests catch a parser that accepts units out of order
arguments: Copy-Item -Force '{scenario}/mutant/DurationParser.cs' 'Durations/DurationParser.cs'; dotnet test Durations.Tests --no-incremental --nologo -v q | Out-Null; exit $LASTEXITCODE
